name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
label: Quest
description: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is but one task remaining, friend. Confront the lich, Ras Frostwhisper, in his lair.
Use the power of the keepsake against the beast - be unrelenting in your actions! Weather the blows that the flailing beast will surely bring down upon you. Do not give in to the pain!
When the ritual is complete, Ras will be mortal once more. It is at that point that he must be slain. Strike him down and take his human head.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You carry the burden of ten thousand restless souls, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ten thousand souls cry out in unison, friend! You have struck a mortal blow to the Scourge and their masters.
